w: Swamishri arrived at Philadelphia at 10.10 am. On reaching the mandir, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha ceremony. More than 2,500 devotees and well-wishers attended the occasion.

Swamishri sanctified the 'Pramukh Swami Institute of Information Technology' at the Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay campus. Swamishri also inspired the youths to excel academically as well as integrate moral and spiritual virtues in their lives.

The Janmashtami celebration commenced at 9.00 p.m. Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami addressed the assembly and thereafter kishores performed a cultural dance. Pujya Viveksagar Swami explained the significance of festivals and thereafter Pujya Mahant Swami addressed the assembly. Kirtans and another cultural dance gave the celebration a devotional and festive flair. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, "On festival days one should sing God's glory, remember Him and live a life that pleases Him. We have to imbibe the knowledge He has imparted and the moral injuctions He has prescribed. God comes on earth to redeem us, therefore we should internalize virtues to please Him. "Many people gamble on this festive day. But that does not please God. However people have tendencies to celebrate festivals by gambling, partying and enjoying themselves in mundane ways...

"God has said in the Gita that there are two types of people: good and evil. When evil increases, God Himself takes birth on earth to destroy it and establish dharma and spiritual values. He transforms a person into a real man and redeems him... God does not like ego. So to please God first, one must give up one's tendency of possessiveness and humbly offer devotion to Him..."
During the evening satsang assembly the murti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honoured by the devotees of Bangalore.
